search.stopping_rule: Three independent starts per pressure, at most 18,000 proposals/start, then a compatible cross-seed refinement up to 24,000 per pressure; stop after 12,000 with 7,000 since last gain. Bounded annealing plateau, not a global proof.

interpretation: Search-pressure candidates on one common 139-city map. Surrogate scores are preference units, not coin payouts. Current configuration excluded from topology selection.
